question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are holding a white elephant gift exchange. At the start of the event, they are each holding a present of a different color: Alice has a red present, Bob has a grey present, Claire has a pink present, Dave has a silver present, Eve has a gold present, Fred has a black present, and Gertrude has a white present.
As the event progresses, pairs of people swap gifts. First, Alice and Bob swap their gifts. Then, Claire and Bob swap their gifts. Then, Alice and Bob swap their gifts. Then, Alice and Bob swap their gifts. Then, Eve and Alice swap their gifts. Then, Bob and Gertrude swap their gifts. Finally, Fred and Eve swap their gifts. At the end of the event, Claire has the
Options:
(A) red present
(B) grey present
(C) pink present
(D) silver present
(E) gold present
(F) black present
(G) white present
solution:
Present colors in order: (Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude).
Initial: (red, grey, pink, silver, gold, black, white).
1. Alice and Bob swap: (grey, red, pink, silver, gold, black, white).
2. Claire and Bob swap: (grey, pink, red, silver, gold, black, white).
3. Alice and Bob swap: (pink, grey, red, silver, gold, black, white).
4. Alice and Bob swap: (grey, pink, red, silver, gold, black, white).
5. Eve and Alice swap: (gold, pink, red, silver, grey, black, white).
6. Bob and Gertrude swap: (gold, white, red, silver, grey, black, pink).
7. Fred and Eve swap: (gold, white, red, silver, black, grey, pink).
Claire has the red present, option (A).
Final answer: (A)
